title: SharePoint: create, upload and publish HTML pages, with Copilot drafting
summary: The briefing is supported by the roadmap record, Microsoft's tenant notice and current Microsoft Learn documentation. The licence-assignment and site-restriction controls are documented, and the briefing correctly distinguishes confirmed behaviour from unanswered questions about HTML uploads.
